user.title: Casio ABL-100WE
user.description: Select a discovered watch or enter its exact Bluetooth address. Discovered: {discovered}

reconfigure.title: Change watch Bluetooth address
reconfigure.description: Only continue if this is the same physical watch with a new Bluetooth address. Select it explicitly or type its exact address; a typed address takes precedence. Existing device and entity identities are preserved. All automatic modes must be off and remain off; enable them separately only when ready. This form does not connect to the watch or verify ownership. Discovered: {discovered}

init.title: Casio ABL-100WE
init.description: Experimental and opt-in: select at most one automatic mode. Bluetooth advertising indicates an availability window, not recognition of CNCT. Reading all data requires an available native ESPHome source and a live advertisement carrying a supported name. Connect and retain reads once and keeps the link until loss or explicit close, without idle or session-lifetime expiry. Physical permanence is not guaranteed and no settings are written automatically. Turn all modes off before changing the address.
